I shaped iteration 0002 (issue #47). The graph is in `.session/tasks.json` and the journal entry is `journal/0002.md`.

**What I ordered:** three independent preparation sessions. They have no dependencies between them and write to separate files. Each has its own verification command:
- `coverage` (researcher, opus/high): list the artifact families and save versions in the prepared sources, show which resource types pylavi decodes, and list the gaps. Report only, no fixes. Output: `docs/research/0002-coverage.md` and `docs/research/scripts/coverage/inventory.py`.
- `delivery` (researcher, opus/high): compare four ways to deliver the tool (CLI export, Python library, MCP server, committed text mirror). Estimate the effort for all LabVIEW versions versus 2024 only, and list what a 2024-only tool could not read. It makes no choice for the owner. Output: `docs/research/0002-delivery.md`.
- `sources` (benchmark, opus/high): the benchmark `sources` milestone. A script records the prepared sources with their pins, licenses and hashes. Output: `benchmark/sources.json`, `sources.md`, `preparation.json` and `scripts/sources.py --check`.

**Why the same three again:** iterations 0000 and 0001 both failed without any session producing output. No `docs/research/` or `benchmark/` files exist. The 0001 shaper report (`.session/reports/44.json`) shows provider parking, not a badly cut task, so I kept the cut. I changed two things. Each task now has a lower limit of 90 min / 100 turns, and each must commit a partial result in the first third of the session, so a pause leaves a branch to resume.

**What I did not order:** no implementation, reviewer or evaluator work. There is still no pinned tree to review and no method the owner has accepted. I made no choice about the 2024 fallback. I wrote no suggestions or requests.

**Checks:** this issue has no `## Verification` section, so there was nothing to run. I also have no shell, so I did not run the tasks' verification commands.

## Discoveries
- The staged reports cover only the two shaper sessions (#27, #44). No work-session report shows why 0000 and 0001 produced nothing, beyond provider parking (`.session/reports/index.json`).
- This session wasted many turns re-reading the protocol, skill and loop state after the context was compacted. I logged this under Avoid in `journal/0002.md`.
